name: Fixture Unreachable Source
notes: Fixture for tools/lib/provider-census_test.sh's unreachable-source mutation. check_url deliberately points at 127.0.0.1:1, a port nothing listens on, so curl fails with connection-refused (exit 7) deterministically offline and online alike — no live GitHub or DNS dependency, and no --offline flag can hide it since the test invokes this fixture WITHOUT --offline on purpose.
